resolutions.researcher_notes: Status 'operating' inferred (not literal). Apache's Feb-2004 MIGA/OPIC EIA describes the 'Northern Gas Pipeline' as an existing 34-inch gas export line already handling all gas from the Khalda/Matruh/Ras Kanayis/Ras El Hekma/Umbarka/South Umbarka concessions (verified via pdftotext; url_verifier 200 but Arabic/ligature PDF defeats the substring screen). OGJ 'Egypt western desert activity hits high gear' documents the Obaiyed->Ameriya gas line entering service (planned service start 1999) and Obaiyed field producing. Two independent origins (Apache/OPIC filing + OGJ trade press) confirm the line is built and carrying gas.

Fuel = Gas confirmed. MIGA EIA: 'Northern Gas Pipeline — A 34 inch gas export line handles all of the gas exported from the Khalda concession...' (verified via pdftotext). OGJ describes it as a gas pipeline from Shell's Obaiyed concession to Egypt's gas grid and a power plant at Ameriya. Two independent sources agree it is a gas line.

VALUE CONTRADICTION. GEM lists Capacity = 600 MMcf/d for this pipeline, but no independent source supports 600 for the Obaiyed-Amreya line itself. The 600 MMcfd figure in the region belongs to the Western Desert Gas Complex (WDGC) Train D at Amreya — a gas-processing plant expansion, NOT this pipeline. The pipeline-side capacity that sources give is different: OGJ ('hits high gear') has Shell's Obaiyed contributing ~300 MMcfd plus ~165 MMcfd of Khalda gas (~465 MMcfd combined). No verifiable source states 600 MMcf/d as the pipeline capacity — flagged for Update review; likely a plant-train figure mis-mapped to the pipe.

VALUE CONTRADICTION. GEM lists LengthKnown = 49.50 km. No source found supports 49.5 km. OGJ ('Egypt western desert activity hits high gear') states 'Shell and Repsol ... plan to construct a 315 km gas pipeline from Shell's Obaiyed concession to Egypt's gas grid and a 640 mw power plant at Ameriya' — i.e. ~315 km for the Obaiyed->Ameriya route, far longer than 49.5 km. (Note the offshore-technology 'Western Desert gas pipeline' data page — 275 km, 24-in, Agiba/Eni/Lukoil, 2027 — is a DIFFERENT, unrelated pipeline and does not apply here.) 49.5 km may be a single segment or an error; no verifiable source corroborates it. Flagged for Update review.

Endpoints Obaiyed gas field (Matruh) -> Amreya/Ameriya (Alexandria) confirmed by two independent sources. OGJ: gas pipeline 'from Shell's Obaiyed concession to Egypt's gas grid and a 640 mw power plant at Ameriya' (Ameriya = Amreya, Alexandria). Egypt Oil & Gas 'The Western Desert' report: 'The Obaiyed gas field is operated by BAPETCO and is located in the Western Desert, 35 km southwest of Matruh' (confirmed via pdftotext of the report PDF; url_verifier 200 but PDF substring screen fails). Start (Obaiyed field, Matruh governorate) and end (Amreya, Alexandria governorate) both supported.

Owner1 = Apache Corp, Owner2 = Shell directly supported by Apache's own Feb-2004 MIGA/OPIC EIA: 'Northern Gas Pipeline ... The line is jointly owned by Apache and Shell with Shell assuming operatorship of the line' (verified via pdftotext). Single strong primary source names both owners, hence medium. NUANCE / possible conflation to flag: the Obaiyed *concession* is 100% Shell (BAPETCO-operated), and OGJ describes the original Obaiyed->Ameriya line as a Shell + Repsol build (~1998). Apache later (2001) acquired Repsol's Western Desert interests and (2010) BP's, so by 2004 the Northern Gas Pipeline is Apache+Shell as GEM lists. Shell is corroborated across both sources; Apache's co-ownership rests on the MIGA EIA.
